notes.subject: Kam klostu ... waskim yu yet
notes.rationale: Verse opens with imperatives summoning the nations to come near and listen — a direct hook.

notes.subject: ol lain bilong ol narapela kantri na ol lain manmeri
notes.rationale: Direct address to the nations and peoples as summoned hearers.

notes.subject: ol lain bilong ol narapela kantri
notes.rationale: גוים literally 'nations/Gentiles'; rendered as a descriptive phrase since Tok Pisin has no single established equivalent.

translation: Kam klostu, ol lain bilong ol narapela kantri, bilong harim; na ol lain manmeri, waskim yu yet long harim: graun i ken harim, na olgeta samting bilong en i ken harim; graun olgeta, na olgeta pikinini bilong en.

tokens.gloss: ol lain bilong ol narapela kantri
